stops.title: Your overview
stops.caption: The front door, and only what your role covers.
stops.speech: This is Kairos. It opens on your overview, and everything you can see here is scoped to what you are actually responsible for.

stops.title: The sidebar
stops.caption: Six groups. You only see the ones your role needs.
stops.speech: The sidebar is grouped into People, Groups, Gatherings, Insights and Organisation. A section you cannot see is simply one your role has no need of.

stops.title: Members
stops.caption: Everybody in one list, with their status on the row.
stops.speech: Members is the directory. Everybody in the church is here, with their home branch and whether they have completed the membership class.

stops.title: Fellowships
stops.caption: Small groups, with a map so people can find one.
stops.speech: Fellowships are the small groups. K-Groups, Kharis Express, New Breeds and the rest, with a map so somebody can find the one nearest them.

stops.title: Departments
stops.caption: Ministry teams, their rotas and their recruitment.
stops.speech: Departments are the ministry teams. Each one keeps its own roster, its serving rota and the people applying to join it.

stops.title: Attendance
stops.caption: Services, check-in, and the weekly registers.
stops.speech: Attendance covers services and check-in. People can check themselves in with a QR code, or the desk can record them on arrival.

stops.title: The souls pipeline
stops.caption: From first contact through to a department.
stops.speech: The souls pipeline follows somebody reached through evangelism: new, following up, interested, converted, and on into discipleship.

stops.title: Reports
stops.caption: Attendance, growth and engagement, scoped to you.
stops.speech: Reports turn all of that into numbers. Attendance trends, membership growth and engagement, again only across what your role covers.

stops.title: Your language
stops.caption: Kairos and this handbook, in four languages.
stops.speech: Kairos speaks English, French, Krio and Twi. Change it from the sidebar, and the handbook opens in the same language you chose.
